exclude.baracuda: Kid-safe: a long jaw full of pointed teeth
exclude.(black|green|purple|red) deep sea fish: Kid-safe: a gaping mouth of long fangs (deep-sea dragonfish)
exclude.(black|brown|purple) fat deep sea fish: Kid-safe: a row of teeth shows in its mouth, and it is near black
exclude.shark: Kid-safe: teeth show in its mouth
exclude.hammerhead shark: Kid-safe, in doubt: small teeth show under its head; and its picture was not uploaded (it draws plain white)
exclude.rock fish: Its pictures were not uploaded (it draws as a plain white lump with a grumpy face) and it is 8,180 triangles
exclude.lobster: 18,304 triangles (367 KB) for a small seabed animal, and its picture was not uploaded (plain white)
exclude.sea urchin: A ball of spines with no picture uploaded; 5,856 triangles

source: branch asset-packs, folder ocean-animals/ (uploaded by the owner, November 2026)
notes: No model has a clip, and the pictures (textures) the FBX files name were not in the upload, so every model draws in plain material colours: the three that ship get one colour each (defaults per item: colours).
Each model's skeleton is baked into its rest pose and replaced by the swimRig spine (idle and swim made in the pipeline); the turtle's flippers beat (flap).

If this repository ever becomes public, the raw files of this pack (branch asset-packs) must be removed first, and the built models in public/vendor/themes/ and the pictures in public/vendor/art2d/ reviewed: the licence forbids redistributing the files as assets.
